issue.title: Audit and refresh stale capture grammar fixtures and generator floors
issue.description: Audit the remaining hand-written fake-bob capture-parse responses, fixture JSON, and generator floors against the grammar-5 gate. Preserve deliberate below-gate tests; refresh real-Bob fixtures from current Bob where needed and make generators reject stale grammar. The approved plan measured 65 inline grammar-3 capture-parse bodies, 107 fixture JSON grammar values at 4 or lower, and a directive fixture generator floor of 3.

task_type_fields.impact: Future fixture-backed tests and capture submit flows can be blocked by stale grammar metadata, masking intended behavior or creating unrelated failures. Audit intentional gate-negative fixtures separately and prevent stale fixtures from being regenerated.
task_type_fields.repro: On current master, count hard-coded capture-parse grammar 3 responses in fake-bob and JSON fixture grammar values <= 4; both remain below CaptureGrammarGate.minimumRevision (5). Scripts/generate-directive-fixtures.sh still validates grammar >= 3. A future submit test using one of these responses silently exercises the outdated-Bob gate.

issue.creation_reason: The approved targeted CI repair updates only failing parse fixtures and exposes a much wider stale grammar surface. This bead tracks the remaining latent hazard so future fixture-backed tests do not silently stop at the grammar gate.
